source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Judges 6–12 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 230 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Keep domination and forced refuge, with the rare mountain shelters rendered cautiously.
Keep the geographical extent and explicit destruction of food and livestock.
Keep fear as allegiance and the accusation in nested divine speech.
Preserve the greeting’s force beside Gideon’s hiding without explaining it as irony or prediction.
Keep Gideon’s protest, collective us and accusation as his speech, not narrator commentary.
Keep the shift from angel to LORD and the unexplained reference to Gideon’s strength.
Preserve the staff, fire’s origin and disappearance without adding an ascent.
Keep recognition, alarm and face-to-face language.
Preserve the difficult two-bull wording rather than silently collapsing it to one animal.
Keep altar arrangement, second bull and cult object used as fuel; note uncertainty of arrangement term.
Keep the explicit demand for death and both stated charges.
Preserve the legal wordplay, threat and challenge without softening the father’s speech.
Retain the Spirit clothing himself with Gideon as a garment, not reversing the image.
